known: Official sources and edition labels are recorded.
prohibited_assumption: A mutable landing page cannot prove an immutable protocol clause.
resolution_condition: Pin clauses/digests and complete independent review.
unknown: Normative clause anchors and content digests are incomplete.

known: More than seventy primary/official specifications span requested families.
resolution_condition: Two independent reviews and scheduled evidence refresh complete without material new families.
unknown: Independent reviewers and recurring saturation searches are absent.

known: Schemas and hostile fixtures model occurrences.
resolution_condition: Register an authorized occurrence and execute scoped conformance probes.
unknown: No real connector deployment, credentials, entitlements, or live probes are asserted.

known: Limit surfaces and receipts are typed.
resolution_condition: Observe every binding-critical limit on the target occurrence.
unknown: Numerical values vary by tenant, region, edition, contract, and time.

known: Protocol and connector delivery states are explicit.
prohibited_assumption: Connector exactly-once is not end-to-end exactly-once.
resolution_condition: Compose and verify an end-to-end effect protocol.
unknown: End-to-end effect requires source, pipeline state, and sink proofs.

known: Snapshot cut and export completion are separate states.
prohibited_assumption: Export completion cannot be treated as snapshot consistency.
resolution_condition: Provide a source-supported cut or declare reconciliation/limitations.
unknown: Many APIs do not expose a stable cross-object cut.

known: Resume-token purpose and expiry are modeled.
prohibited_assumption: A readable token is not proof of resumability.
resolution_condition: Qualify restart across supported topology and version transitions.
unknown: Topology/version changes may invalidate tokens differently per source.

known: Transport and application receipts are distinct.
prohibited_assumption: HTTP 2xx cannot prove downstream business processing.
resolution_condition: Declare at-least-once plus application deduplication or a stronger verified profile.
unknown: Many webhook producers expose no durable business-acceptance receipt.

known: Blocking and code-page decisions are explicit.
prohibited_assumption: Do not infer record layout from file suffix.
resolution_condition: Acquire authoritative layouts and validate hostile byte fixtures.
unknown: Site copybooks, control totals, code pages, and truncation behavior are occurrence-owned.

known: Industrial commands compile read-only by default.
prohibited_assumption: Authentication alone never authorizes a physical command.
resolution_condition: Obtain control authority and pass destructive-guard tests in an approved environment.
unknown: Safety authority, interlocks, and physical outcome receipts are site-specific.

known: Primary publisher catalogues identify several standards.
prohibited_assumption: A public overview is not the full conformance specification.
resolution_condition: Record licensed clause-level evidence under permitted redistribution terms.
unknown: Some full normative texts require licensed access.

known: Browser enqueue and collector acceptance are separate.
prohibited_assumption: API call success does not prove network delivery.
resolution_condition: Qualify each browser/profile and reconcile server receipts.
unknown: User agent lifecycle and privacy policies can drop or reduce telemetry.

known: Generic SaaS API protocol classes are represented.
prohibited_assumption: Do not create a connector class from a SaaS vendor name.
resolution_condition: Bind a provider adapter offer with current official docs and occurrence probes.
unknown: Object authority, rate policies, bulk jobs, deletions, and change semantics are provider-specific.

known: License and SBOM surfaces are required.
prohibited_assumption: Protocol openness does not make every client library redistributable.
resolution_condition: Complete artifact-specific license, export, vulnerability, provenance and support review.
unknown: No implementation artifact has been selected or legally reviewed.

known: Cost is an occurrence-level finite budget.
prohibited_assumption: A protocol request count is not a monetary cost.
resolution_condition: Snapshot official pricing/contract evidence and reconcile actual bills.
unknown: Pricing tiers, egress, minimums and request classification are mutable.
